payload.name: OpenERP — Dependabot remediation
payload.goal: Remédier les 25 alertes Dependabot ouvertes (bumps compatibles, gates verts, publication main) via réalisation GPT 5.3 xhigh + double-consensus 5.6-terra xhigh; Opus 4.8 xhigh seulement au besoin.

payload.note: Inventoried 25 open Dependabot alerts across 10 packages (hono, @hono/node-server major 1->2, vitest, vite, esbuild, markdown-it, dompurify, brace-expansion, linkify-it, fast-uri). Realization delegated to Codex gpt-5.3 xhigh run dependabot_fix (model accepted); no commit/push delegated. Next: 5.6-terra xhigh double-consensus review, conductor gates+publish main.

BLOCKED on realization model. Both gpt-5.3 and gpt-5.3-terra rejected by ChatGPT account (HTTP 400 unsupported). No repo changes left by failed runs. gpt-5.6-terra remains the only confirmed-working Codex id. Awaiting owner choice: 5.6-terra for realization, Opus 4.8 xhigh, or exact 5.3 identifier. No silent fallback.

Realization done via gpt-5.3-codex-spark (slug found in ~/.codex/models_cache.json). Conductor caught+reverted scope-creep (worker health-server 127.0.0.1 bind, unrelated to deps, would narrow health endpoint); kept required vite.config es2022 fix (web build fails without it under esbuild 0.28). All 10 targets at patched floors; npm audit --omit=dev=0; all workspace tests green (api 1618, worker 55, bank-connector 27, domain 11, i18n 4); build/lint/checks green. 5 residual audit findings are dev-only tooling outside the Dependabot set. Launched gpt-5.6-terra double-consensus review dependabot_review before commit.

Realization via Codex gpt-5.3-codex-spark, double-consensus via gpt-5.6-terra on the main lot; conductor caught+reverted a scope-creep worker-bind regression and confirmed a sandbox-only test EPERM was not a real failure. npm audit --omit=dev: 0; all workspace lint/build/test green (api 1618, worker 55, bank-connector 27, domain 11, i18n 4).
